design.correct: published simulator; internal baseline on the reduced seed set

ar2_obs.description: observation noise AR(2) in EXTENDED and stale regimes; the latent path is the published simulator's path

t_jumps.description: latent jumps Student-t(3), scaled to sd 3*sigma; the jump probability stays 0.005

regime_noise.description: declared OPEN/EXTENDED labels flipped with probability 0.15; the latent path and P are unchanged

latent_regime.description: hidden two-state stale/regular observation state during OPEN/EXTENDED hours; the model and policy see the calendar

design.note: the model side is fixed at the G0 kappa/mu/jump and G0 h for every variant; this is an estimator stress test, not re-estimation

limits: The model side is not re-estimated inside the suite: kappa/mu/jump and h stay at their G0 values, so the suite measures estimator sensitivity to the DGP perturbation, not a full refit.
Each variant changes one ingredient. Interactions (e.g., AR(2) observation noise plus regime noise) are not covered.
Each variant is run at one perturbation magnitude (15% label flips, 7.4% hidden occupancy, the stated AR(2) coefficients, t(3) jumps); dose-response is not mapped.
The reduced seed set is smaller than the main L1 run; coverage SEs are correspondingly larger and are reported per cell.
regime_noise changes the labels used by both the policy and the model; it is a calendar-classification error, not a change in the latent observation law.
latent_regime keeps the calendar in the model and policy; only the observation law has a hidden state. The hidden state is simulation-only and is never passed to an estimator.
The estimand remains the same model-based target policy value; this suite does not add IPS/DR or a real-data check.
